object: mixed end-of-life vehicle aluminium scrap
problem: Can mixed wrought and cast ELV aluminium scrap be directly upcycled into a high-performance alloy without sorting or dilution?
mechanism_or_method: Rapid-solidification process using heterostructure and accelerated precipitation principles tailored to shredded ELV scrap compositions under industrial conditions.
limitation: Demonstrated at process scale on selected scrap compositions; long-term performance and cost not shown in abstract.
decision_relevance: Enables direct ELV aluminium recycling without sorting into high-strength alloys.

object: radiative cooling coating with CO2-sequestered fillers
problem: How can a radiative cooling coating cut CO2 across its full life cycle, not only the service stage?
mechanism_or_method: Hydromagnesite fillers from CO2 mineral sequestration enveloped by durable PVDF resin in a hierarchical spherical structure, guided by life cycle assessment.
limitation: Life-cycle benefit depends on assumed baselines and climate scenarios; real outdoor durability over years not established.
decision_relevance: Guides coating material selection toward carbon-negative fillers for buildings.

object: high-entropy oxide Zn-air battery cathode electrocatalysts
problem: How does multilevel disorder in high-entropy oxides turn an inactive matrix into an active bifunctional oxygen catalyst?
mechanism_or_method: Increasing cation number to induce structural, electronic and atomic disorder in MnNiCoFe-CeO2 producing stable active sites.
limitation: Lab-scale cells; scalability and long-term durability beyond tests are not demonstrated.

object: PVA-based organo-hydrogels with aligned wrinkles
problem: Can geometry-programmed self-wrinkling give hydrogels mechanical robustness and anisotropic deformation, fracture and ion transport without patterning?
mechanism_or_method: Spontaneous aligned wrinkle formation during thermal-evaporative gelation of poly(vinyl alcohol) organo-hydrogels under geometric constraint.
limitation: Lab demonstrations of sensors; durability and scale-up under real use not shown.

object: free-standing ZIF-62 MOF-glass gas separation membrane
problem: How can large crack-free MOF-glass sheets be made for molecular sieving membranes despite high melt viscosity and densification?
mechanism_or_method: Selecting supporting materials matching thermal and mechanical behaviour of ZIF-62 and optimizing melting-to-testing steps to form crack-free self-supported glass membrane.
limitation: Permeability extremely low; upscaling and thickness reduction remain open challenges.

object: laser directed energy deposited refractory high-entropy alloy
problem: Can additive manufacturing without post-treatment give refractory high-entropy alloys better high-temperature strength and ductility than as-cast ones?
mechanism_or_method: Laser directed energy deposition from elemental powder blends introduces dense intrinsic edge dislocations that enhance strain hardening and kink-band deformability.
limitation: Single composition; elongation only about 6.8 percent at 1000 C and no creep or oxidation data.
decision_relevance: Supports AM route over casting for refractory alloy components.

object: laser-induced graphene soft actuators
problem: How can laser programming create soft actuators with freeform morphing motions without trading off manufacturing simplicity?
mechanism_or_method: Spatially differentiated laser control of energy and scribing direction tunes electrothermal heterogeneity and stiffness anisotropy to encode four motion units.
limitation: Lab-scale demonstrations; actuation speed, durability and energy efficiency not quantified in abstract.
decision_relevance: Guides design of modular morphing units for soft robots.

object: Drosophila wing deployment
problem: What physical mechanics let insect wings unfold and expand rapidly from a folded pupal structure?
mechanism_or_method: Imaging of wing structure and hemolymph flow plus a computational model with measured viscoelastic properties revealing a nonlinear operating point for deployment.
limitation: Single species; model relies on measured properties of one wing type.
decision_relevance: Informs design of pressure-driven deployable soft structures.

object: elastic rolling cam joints for embodied-intelligence robots
problem: How can joints with inverse-designable rotational stiffness encode mechanical intelligence in robots?
mechanism_or_method: Elastic rolling cam with inverse-designed stiffness profiles used as passive knees and morphing joints in bipedal robot and quadcopter.
limitation: Demonstrated on prototype robots in controlled settings; generality of stiffness encoding for other tasks unproven.
decision_relevance: Enables passive-joint stiffness design to replace active control in legged robots.

object: amphiphilic polymer-infiltrated nanoparticle films
problem: How can nanoporous films condense undersaturated vapor and also release liquid water as droplets?
mechanism_or_method: Tuning polymer fraction and nanoparticle size balances polymer hydrophobicity and capillarity so condensate fills voids then exudes onto the surface.
limitation: Only isothermal lab conditions; collection rates and durability under ambient cycling not shown.

object: Yellowstone caldera earthquake swarms
problem: What controls the spatial and temporal evolution of earthquake swarms in the Yellowstone volcanic system?
mechanism_or_method: Deep-learning phase picking and 3D velocity model build a 15-year catalog; swarm clustering and migration analysis infer fluid diffusion and episodic injection.
limitation: Fluid-driven interpretation is inferred from seismicity patterns without direct fluid measurements.

object: optical metasurface-driven microscopic gear machines
problem: Can microscopic gears and racks be driven by light through metasurfaces to break the 0.1 mm miniaturization limit?
mechanism_or_method: Metasurface-patterned driving gear activated by plane light wave, fabricated by standard lithography and coupled to gear trains and pinion-rack machines.
limitation: Proof of principle; torque, wear and efficiency in practical systems are not characterized in abstract.
decision_relevance: Offers on-chip light-powered micromachine drive alternative to micromotors.

object: light-triggered azobenzene liquid-crystalline polymer jumper
problem: How can stiffness patterning overcome the curvature-stiffness trade-off to raise snap-through energy release efficiency?
mechanism_or_method: Spatially programmed stiffness variation in Azo-LCP localizes curvature and boosts photomechanical strain, with symmetry placement setting jump direction.
limitation: Lab-scale light-driven jumpers; efficiency values and repeatability limits not reported in abstract.
decision_relevance: Guides stiffness-patterned design of snap-through soft actuators.

object: magnetic nanoparticle assemblies in phase transitional matrix
problem: How can electronics be reconfigured after manufacture without sacrificing electrical stability?
mechanism_or_method: Patterned magnetic fields assemble nanoparticle conductive percolation in a phase-transitional matrix that tightens junctions during phase transition.
limitation: Demonstrations limited to switching and a display; cycling endurance and scale unclear.

object: programmable acoustic metamaterial with dual-state unit cells
problem: Can a metamaterial reconfigure vibration fields in real time to shape multi-touch tactile stimuli?
mechanism_or_method: Unit cells switch electronically between vibration sources and passive resonators, with self-tuned subwavelength band gaps at the carrier frequency of powered cells.
limitation: Operates around 200 Hz with off-the-shelf motors; resolution and human perception studies not detailed.
decision_relevance: Informs low-cost haptic display design using vibration-motor arrays.

object: untethered magnetic jamming composites
problem: Can jamming transitions be actuated magnetically without vacuum tethers for programmable stiffness structures?
mechanism_or_method: Soft-ferromagnetic composite subunits with programmed magnetization jam under external magnetic fields, modeled with a magneto-mechanical description.
limitation: Needs external field source; stiffness gains and field strength requirements not quantified in abstract.
decision_relevance: Informs untethered variable-stiffness design for soft robots.

object: e-textile electromagnetic energy recovery from the body
problem: Can the human body's dielectric polarization be used to harvest ambient electromagnetic energy at milliwatt level?
mechanism_or_method: Textile exploits body space-charge and dipole polarization to convert electromagnetic energy directly from skin surface without separate generation entities.
limitation: Power depends on proximity to strong emitters such as a typing laptop; few subjects likely.

object: cholesteric liquid crystal Bouligand thin films
problem: How can biomimetic Bouligand helical structures be realized in thin films with programmable electro-optical and mechanical response?
mechanism_or_method: Chemically patterned alternating surface anchoring directs cholesteric liquid crystals into hierarchical helices with secondary left- and right-handed twist, supported by simulations.
limitation: Thin-film lab scale; mechanical enhancement magnitude and large-area patterning not detailed.

object: electrolytic cement recycler for clinker precursor
problem: Can waste cement be electrochemically converted into calcium hydroxide clinker precursor with low CO2 emissions?
mechanism_or_method: Cement electrolyzer coupled to a digestion vessel generates acid and base, converting waste cement into Ca(OH)2 and silica at up to 300 mA per cm2.
limitation: Lab electrolyzer scale; clinker quality and energy demand at industrial scale not shown.
decision_relevance: Supports recycling waste cement instead of virgin limestone for clinker feedstock.

object: aligned CNT electroactive polymer nanocomposite actuators
problem: How can the conflict between deformability and rigidity in electroactive polymer actuators be resolved?
mechanism_or_method: Electric-field alignment of Al2O3-coated carbon nanotubes in P(VDF-TrFE-CTFE) boosts thickness strain and local stiffness via face-enhanced effect.
limitation: Requires high driving field of 30 V per micrometre; lifetime and scale-up not discussed.
decision_relevance: Guides filler alignment choice for high-force soft polymer actuators.

object: hydrogen tunneling in palladium
problem: How does proton tunneling between interstitial sites in Pd couple with phonons and conduction electrons?
mechanism_or_method: Nuclear reaction analysis and resistance measurements directly observe tetrahedral-to-octahedral hopping and its temperature dependence, fitting electron coupling constant K.
limitation: Single metal system at cryogenic temperatures; relevance to practical hydrogen storage not shown.

object: nickel molecular catalyst for amino-acid reactive CO2 capture
problem: How can a CO-producing catalyst resist amino acid adsorption while activating limited CO2 in reactive capture?
mechanism_or_method: Carbon-nanotube-supported conjugated NiPc framework with coordinatively unsaturated Ni-N3 sites repels amino acids and promotes CO2 adsorption.
limitation: Energy cost 25 GJ per tonne CO remains high; long-term stability not stated.

object: nanoporous graphene membranes for CO2 capture
problem: How can CO2-selective angstrom pores be introduced into graphene at room temperature at scale?
mechanism_or_method: Micro-channeled flow reactor overcomes ozone mass-transfer and byproduct polarization limits, giving tenfold higher pore density in ambient oxidation.
limitation: Centimeter-scale only; selectivity of 21 modest and larger-area membrane integrity unproven.

object: polyacrylonitrile-chitosan sorbent spheres for cation separation
problem: Can humidity control exploit deliquescence differences to selectively adsorb alkali and alkaline earth salts, including lithium?
mechanism_or_method: Composite spheres adsorb salts selectively at controlled humidity levels matching each salt's deliquescent humidity range.
limitation: Lab-scale tests; performance with real brines and sorbent regeneration cycles unclear.

object: Co3O4 thermochemical energy storage particles
problem: How do particle size and porosity evolve and degrade Co3O4 redox performance over thermal cycles?
mechanism_or_method: Operando synchrotron transmission X-ray microscopy nanotomography with thermal analysis tracks 3D morphology and chemistry at 800-900 C.
limitation: Few cycles and model particles; behaviour in packed beds at plant scale unknown.
decision_relevance: Favors nanoparticle sizing to limit pore-induced degradation in thermochemical storage materials.

object: borate-driven porous PDMS elastomers
problem: How can porous elastomers achieve improved tribological and mechanical performance without surfactants?
mechanism_or_method: Borate at the two-phase boundary stabilizes phases; removing alcoholysis phase gives controllable pores and corrosion-lubrication under saltwater.
limitation: Lubrication benefit demonstrated under saltwater lab tribometry; field wear life unknown.
decision_relevance: Suggests porous PDMS for water-lubricated components with lower friction and wear.

object: fluorinated polyamide nanofilm membranes
problem: How can membranes achieve high solvent permeance, low molecular weight cutoff and chemical stability simultaneously?
mechanism_or_method: Interfacial polymerization with contorted fluorinated segments in a flexible hydrophilic backbone builds a Janus microporous framework.
limitation: Lab membranes; long-term operation with industrial solvent mixtures not reported.

object: aerogel Leidenfrost vapor percolator
problem: How can ultralight materials suppress the Leidenfrost effect for fast high-temperature cooling?
mechanism_or_method: Controlled drying stress and welding of hollow nanofibers build directed nano/micro tunnels that evacuate vapor and reconstruct flow topology.
limitation: Tested with droplet and injection cooling of lab surfaces; mechanical durability under repeated quench unclear.
decision_relevance: Informs lightweight thermal management design for aerospace high-heat-flux cooling.

object: bicontinuous multiscale microstructures
problem: How can multifunctional bicontinuous structures be designed quickly despite lacking analytical expressions and facing costly multiscale optimization?
mechanism_or_method: Active learning with a generative AI model builds L-BOM datasets of boundary-identical open-cell microstructures for data-driven inverse design.
limitation: Properties are simulated; experimental validation of printed structures not described in abstract.
decision_relevance: Speeds selection of lattice microstructures with target elasticity and permeability.

object: solar-driven liquid direct air capture to sustainable aviation fuel
problem: Is a solar-calciner DAC system integrated with direct CO2-Fischer-Tropsch synthesis technically and economically viable at 1 Mt per year?
mechanism_or_method: Process modelling, simulation, scale-up and techno-economic assessment of hydrogen-fluidised solar calciner integrated with one-step CO2-FTS.
limitation: Fuel price of US$4.62 per kg is high; relies on model assumptions with no pilot validation.
decision_relevance: Guides siting and roadmap decisions for solar-powered DAC-to-fuel plants.

object: liquid crystal topological defect arrays under surface acoustic waves
problem: How can acoustic topological wavefields dynamically control liquid crystal defect arrays in a reconfigurable way?
mechanism_or_method: Superposed surface acoustic waves create potential landscapes and streaming vortices that realign the director, described by Ginzburg-Landau free energy modeling.
limitation: Small-scale lab platform; response speed and device integration for photonics not shown.

object: flexible coordination framework sorbent for Kr/Xe separation
problem: How can krypton be preferentially adsorbed over xenon at room temperature to avoid high desorption energy?
mechanism_or_method: Metal-organic framework with structural and local ligand flexibility enables kinetic sieving of Kr through transiently expanded channels.
limitation: Kr uptake modest at 36.8 cm3 per cm3; process-scale cycling stability not shown.

object: droplet impact on elastic substrates
problem: How does maximum droplet impact force scale on soft substrates where both droplet and substrate deform?
mechanism_or_method: High-speed photoelastic tomography of dynamic stress fields identifies a similarity parameter governing a crossover from inertial to Hertzian impact scaling.
limitation: Controlled lab impacts on model elastic substrates; viscoelastic and rough real surfaces not covered.
decision_relevance: Changes impact-force estimates used in designing soft impact-resistant surfaces.

object: textured TiNi elastocaloric alloy with Ti4Ni2O precipitates
problem: How can TiNi shape memory alloys keep large elastocaloric effect through ten million cycles?
mechanism_or_method: Directional solidification yields columnar textured B2 grains with aligned Ti4Ni2O precipitates that guide confined B19' martensite growth.
limitation: Compressive loading on small samples; scale-up of directional solidification and device-level performance unproven.
decision_relevance: Guides microstructure design of fatigue-resistant elastocaloric refrigerant alloys.

object: doubly curved origami shells
problem: How can origami shells be smooth, load-bearing and have reprogrammable stiffness at once?
mechanism_or_method: Tileable crease pattern from inverse problem folds into smooth doubly curved shapes; tendons with varying pre-tension lock and tune stiffness.
limitation: Prototype-scale shells; long-term creep and large-scale deployment loads not evaluated.
decision_relevance: Enables flat-pack deployable shells with tunable stiffness for structures.

object: end-of-life photovoltaic waste flows
problem: How can cross-border governance and traceable systems manage degraded photovoltaic modules flowing to emerging markets?
mechanism_or_method: Commentary arguing for traceable end-of-life systems and cross-border governance of module flows.
limitation: Abstract gives only a brief position statement without quantitative evidence.
decision_relevance: Informs policy on tracing and recycling exported used photovoltaic modules.

object: ultralight soft electrostatic actuators with gaseous dielectrics
problem: How can gas as a third phase raise power-to-weight ratio of electrohydraulic soft actuators and what limits it?
mechanism_or_method: Solid-liquid-gas architecture in Peano-HASEL actuators replaces liquid mass with gas; breakdown limit governed by Paschen's law guides gas selection.
limitation: Gas breakdown caps performance; C4F7N mixtures are costly with environmental concerns and only one jumping robot shown.
decision_relevance: Guides gas dielectric choice for lightweight electrohydraulic actuators.

object: end-of-life separation membranes
problem: Can end-of-life water membranes be regenerated by dissolution and re-casting with better performance than new ones?
mechanism_or_method: Dissolve EOL membrane in organic solvent and re-cast; residual foulants act as pore formers and hydrophilic additives and reduced entanglement aids dense layer formation.
limitation: Tested on limited membrane types; variability of foulants across real EOL membranes unclear.

object: solar evaporator for seawater desalination brine
problem: How can scaling-free zero liquid discharge of brine be achieved without chemical additives?
mechanism_or_method: Regulating mass transfer distance in a solar evaporator enhances MgSO4 backflow from the evaporation interface, suppressing cocrystallization scaling.
limitation: Tests of 408 hours and short outdoor trials; long-term scaling at larger scale unproven.
decision_relevance: Guides evaporator mass-transfer geometry to avoid scaling in brine management.

object: spent Li-ion battery cathode recycling flow cell
problem: Can multiple spent cathode types be recycled together via redox-mediated leaching while generating electricity?
mechanism_or_method: Redox-targeting flow cell uses spent LiFePO4 and layered oxides as anodic and cathodic feedstocks with hydrogen looping for acid and base regeneration.
limitation: Electricity and economics are calculated projections from lab cells, not pilot data.

object: asymmetric thermochromic ionogels
problem: How can thermochromic materials combine optical switching, toughness and environmental tolerance for smart windows?
mechanism_or_method: Dynamic in situ phase separation in hydrophobic ionic liquid builds a thermoresponsive scattering layer bonded to a reinforced supporting layer.
limitation: Lab-scale samples; outdoor weathering and large-area window performance not shown.

object: liquid water layer gas separation membrane
problem: Can a thin water layer in hydrophilic sub-100-nm pores serve as a high-performance CO2 selective membrane?
mechanism_or_method: Capillary-stabilized water selective layer where selectivity follows gas solubility and permeance is tuned by layer thickness below 200 nm.
limitation: Week-long operation only; long-term water stability and impurity effects in real flue gas untested.

object: CoCrFeMnNi high-entropy alloy surface
problem: Does local chemical order exist at high-entropy alloy surfaces and can it be directly observed?
mechanism_or_method: Scanning tunneling microscopy resolves quasi-long-range sqrt5 ordered domains, with DFT identifying local chemical order within supercells.
limitation: Ultra-high-vacuum clean surfaces; link to corrosion or catalytic properties not yet demonstrated.

object: lotus-leaf-mimetic catalytic cleaning membranes
problem: How can polymeric membranes become self-cleaning with strong antifouling and flux recovery for water purification?
mechanism_or_method: HHTP-Co intermediate layer mediates MnO2 mineralization giving oxygen-vacancy-rich catalytic surface and nano/micro water pockets.
limitation: Lab filtration tests with model foulants; long-term real wastewater performance unclear.

object: additively manufactured medium-entropy alloy
problem: How can a metallic alloy keep strength-ductility balance from 77 to 873 K?
mechanism_or_method: AM Co30Cr13Fe13Ni30Al6Ti7Nb1 with heat treatment gives hierarchical grains, cells, L12 nanoprecipitates and rod-like L21 phases sustaining multiscale strain hardening.
limitation: Single composition and tensile tests only; fatigue, creep and oxidation not evaluated.
decision_relevance: Supports hierarchical ordered microstructures for AM parts across cryogenic to elevated temperatures.

object: 3D-printed NiTi elastocaloric refrigerants
problem: Can 3D-printed NiTi achieve both high cycling durability and large specific temperature change for elastocaloric cooling?
mechanism_or_method: Defect-minimized bimodal microstructures facilitate martensitic transformation while suppressing dislocation slip and crack propagation; printed into a cooling prototype.
limitation: Prototype temperature span only 20 C; system-level efficiency and scale-up not shown.
decision_relevance: Supports additive manufacturing as route to elastocaloric refrigerant elements.

object: solar-powered membrane-adsorption evaporator for lithium extraction
problem: Can solar evaporation, adsorption and osmotic membranes be combined to extract lithium from complex brines without extra energy?
mechanism_or_method: Lithium manganese oxide coated cotton evaporator with osmotic membrane at root raises Li/Mg selectivity and prevents divalent scaling via osmosis and capillarity.
limitation: Tested only in simulated brines; real brine impurities and scale-up not addressed.

object: ZnS/graphdiyne mercury vapor adsorbent
problem: How can interfacial bonding design give efficient Hg0 capture from flue gas with high SO2?
mechanism_or_method: Hydrothermal ZnS/graphdiyne with sp C-S-Zn interfacial hybridization transfers charge and creates active adsorption sites near sulfur defects.
limitation: Simulated flue gas lab tests; real flue gas contaminants and adsorbent regeneration not shown.

object: self-assembly of momentum-carrying dry particles
problem: How can kinetic granular particles self-assemble into arrays with programmable density and symmetry without jamming?
mechanism_or_method: Embedded anti-repellent trap structures capture moving particles individually and hold them against collisions during dynamic assembly.
limitation: Demonstrated for specific particle sizes and trap templates; throughput and scaling not detailed.

object: glassy polymer self-healing via oscillatory deformation
problem: Can controlled oscillatory deformation raise molecular mobility in polymer glasses enough to repair cracks?
mechanism_or_method: Molecular dynamics simulations apply oscillations of suitable frequency and amplitude to accelerate glassy dynamics and promote flow around crack surfaces.
limitation: Simulation only on model glass and idealized cylindrical crack; no experimental validation.

object: tectonic tremor synchronization on plate boundaries
problem: Why do some fault segments produce periodic extensive tremor while others are asynchronous?
mechanism_or_method: Measure synchronous segment size from tremor catalogs and relate to regional earthquake rate, explained by competition between self-synchronization and perturbation.
limitation: Correlation-based inference; causal role of small earthquakes not directly demonstrated.

object: covalent organic framework photoactuator film
problem: How can a charged redox-active framework film convert light to mechanical bending rapidly and reversibly?
mechanism_or_method: Triple conversion cascade of light to chemical, thermal and mechanical energy; local heat removes water creating a hydrogen-bond gradient that bends the film.
limitation: Needs UV light and humidity control; payload capacity and cycling durability unclear.

object: topological acoustics
problem: How can topological sound control be translated into industry-relevant computing, communication, energy and sensing functions?
mechanism_or_method: Comment outlining a research vision for topological acoustic and phononic metamaterials.
limitation: Perspective piece without new data or demonstrations.

object: modular truss robots that grow by consuming parts
problem: Can robots grow and adapt physically by integrating parts from other machines or their environment?
mechanism_or_method: Truss modular robot platform with simple repertoire of modules lets robots absorb and shed components to grow bigger, faster and more capable.
limitation: Conceptual lab demonstration with manual-like assembly conditions; autonomy and reliability at scale not shown.

object: hematite-aluminium thermite redox reaction
problem: What are the femtosecond electronic dynamics and ignition mechanism of the Fe2O3/Al thermite reaction?
mechanism_or_method: Ultrafast extreme-UV transient absorption spectroscopy at Fe M and Al L edges tracks polaron formation and electron transfer after optical pulse ignition.
limitation: Thin-film model samples under femtosecond excitation, far from bulk thermite combustion conditions.

object: soft logic gates with piezoresistive switches and dielectric elastomer actuators
problem: How can soft logic gates switch at high frequency for electrostatic soft robots?
mechanism_or_method: Graphite framework/PDMS piezoresistive switch with large resistance change at tiny strain drives DEAs, forming NOT gate oscillator up to 78 Hz.
limitation: Needs high-voltage driving for DEAs; complex circuits and long-term reliability not shown.

object: soft porous metamaterial buckling under inflation
problem: Can inflation-induced buckling in porous soft metamaterials provide programmable actuation and sequencing?
mechanism_or_method: Rubber slab with periodic holes and single internal pressure cavity buckles with controllable lobe count, predicted by analytical and numerical models.
limitation: Pneumatic prototypes only; fatigue and speed of repeated buckling transitions not discussed.
decision_relevance: Guides geometry choice for single-input pneumatic soft actuators and valves.

object: frictional strength of rough contacts
problem: How does roughness alignment between contacting surfaces regulate static friction and stick-slip transition?
mechanism_or_method: Rotating one rough surface relative to another varies matching; contact fabric tensor anisotropy quantifies asperity interaction and predicts friction onset.
limitation: Abstract does not state experimental validation; idealized rough surfaces may omit adhesion and wear.
decision_relevance: Informs surface texturing alignment choices for controlling friction in mechanical interfaces.

object: droplet-based electricity generator arrays with micro-supercapacitors
problem: How can large droplet-based generator arrays keep per-cell output and store pulsed electricity efficiently?
mechanism_or_method: Bottom electrode area matched to droplet spread area doubles power; 400-cell micro-supercapacitor array stores output chiplessly at 21.8% efficiency.
limitation: Output only 81.2 microwatts and tested under lab droplet impacts.

object: long-haul heavy-duty electric truck routing and charging
problem: How can path, speed and charging planning minimize carbon footprint of timely e-truck deliveries at scale?
mechanism_or_method: Stage-expanded graph formulation decomposes routing and charging into tractable subproblems with an efficient algorithm having performance guarantees.
limitation: Simulation on highway data; assumes known grid carbon intensity and charger availability, not field-tested.
decision_relevance: Guides e-truck route, speed and charging scheduling to cut emissions.
